items.title: Scott Jimmy — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: having Seymour Stein – who was a big-shot music mogul – hear you and able to give you a contract

ctx.x: It was a little reporter that lived in Brooklyn. He called and told me what was going on.
Then did you hear from Seymour Stein? Did he call you? Or you don’t recall that?
